author: Isabella Paoletto
title: Professional Bull Riders shows coming to San Diego - NewsBreak
text:
By Isabella Paoletto ,
7 hours ago
SAN DIEGO (FOX 5/KUSI) — Professional Bull Riders is putting on a show in San Diego for the first time in over a decade.
The international bull riding organization is headquartered in Texas and is one of the largest organizations in the world.
The group of more than 800 riders around the world was originally created in 1992 by 20 bull riders who pitched in $1,000 each to create a show that could garner mainstream attention, according to the organization's website .
Since then, the group has secured partnerships with brands like Monster Energy, Cooper Tires and Ram Trucks, and is broadcast to more than 405MM households in more than 91 territories.
The Professional Bull Riders show will take place at Pechanga Arena on Friday, Feb. 5 and Saturday, Feb. 6. In a news release Thursday, the bull riding group called it "the ultimate eight-second man-versus-beast showdown."
The San Diego stop is part of the group's Pendleton Whisky Velocity Tour, which began in 2014 as part of the organization's expansion tour.
Tickets for the show go on sale Thursday.
